shots.purpose: Launch the scene as Fuzzby’s self-appointed parade already in motion: funny because his importance is faster than his steering.
shots.performanceAssignment: Fuzzby’s chest and chin lead like he is announcing a parade before his eyes have chosen a route. His wings commit too hard, so every dodge becomes an overcorrection: a shoulder clips one stem, the stem whips back into nearby petals, pollen clings to him, and his attempt to shake it off only throws him into the next near-miss. He refuses to acknowledge any of it until the final pop-back, where he arrests himself in a strained official hover, the body still dusted in evidence. Lip-sync the approved @Audio1 performance exactly; no additional speech.
shots.camera: The camera follows and struggles to keep up with Fuzzby, briefly losing him behind stems and pollen bursts; Zenny remains readable in depth as the calm measure he keeps orbiting past.
shots.openingPose: Bee-height between towering flower stems, Fuzzby already slanting hard across the frame with pollen streaming from his path; Zenny is deeper among the flowers, level and undisturbed over her own work.
shots.cutInMotivation: Cutting to Zenny’s steadier frame is stronger than staying in the chase because remaining continuous would trap us inside Fuzzby’s self-image; the comedy needs his chaos measured against competence, not merely extended.
shots.dialogueBinding: Fuzzby's vocal beat performs per the approved voice design.
shots.visualPayoff: Fuzzby reappears, dusted by the task he meant to command, while pollen hangs behind him like failed parade confetti. Lip-sync the approved @Audio1 performance exactly; no additional speech.

shots.dialogueTimingProse: Use the approved @Audio1 exactly. Fuzzby’s chant begins after the first committed wingbeat, locked to the dodge-hit-recover rhythm and smearing into the mishap. “Nailed it.” lands after the pop-back and tiny held official pose, followed by a short beat for the remaining pollen drift or body wobble to answer him.
shots.referenceRolesProse: Fuzzby and Zenny character references anchor identity and scale; the approved rainforest/flower Scene Look anchors towering stems, pollen behavior, depth and lighting; @Audio1 anchors lip-sync, pacing and vocal energy.
shots.principalPerformanceApproved: Fuzzby drives the chant as exertion and self-hype — “BIZZY-BIZZY-BIZZY, BIZZY-BIZZY-BIZZY…” — then covers an obvious mishap with “Nailed it.” as if saying it can restore authority. Zenny stays absorbed in her precise gathering, not yet granting him the stage.
shots.animationTimingApproved: Keep the chant on quick, effortful wingbeats: short accelerations, tiny panic-corrections, and no graceful glide. Contacts read in crisp cause-and-effect bursts — hit, spring-back, pollen bloom — with Fuzzby always recovering a fraction late. On “Nailed it.” give him a miniature held pose, just long enough for pride to appear, then let one last pollen drift or body wobble betray the cover-up.

lines.speaker: Fuzzby
lines.dramaticIntention: Self-hype as command: Fuzzby is announcing his own importance while using the chant to power through a route he has not actually controlled.
lines.subtext: Everyone should notice how official and fast I am—please do not notice I am one wingbeat from disaster.
lines.cadenceAndBreath: Bright, clipped, effortful bursts on each “BIZZY,” with tiny pressure spikes as if each dodge costs him. Keep the hyphenated repetitions crisp and forward-driving; let the final ellipsis trail/smear slightly as the mishap overtakes his confidence.
lines.timingAndBody: Do not start on frame one; begin just after the first committed wingbeat. Lock the syllable pulses to quick wingbeats and overcorrections: dodge, clip, recover late. Let the final stretch carry into the stem hit/pollen bloom rather than resolving cleanly.

lines.speaker: Fuzzby
lines.dramaticIntention: A strained official cover-up: Fuzzby tries to make the declaration itself erase the visible evidence of chaos.
lines.subtext: If I say this calmly enough, maybe the pollen, wobble, and everyone’s eyes will agree with me.
lines.cadenceAndBreath: Small inhale or breath-led start, then two compact words with forced certainty. “Nailed” gets the little pride push; “it” is clipped, held together by dignity rather than truth.
lines.timingAndBody: Land only after the pop-back and the tiny arrested hover pose. Keep the voice contained and slightly winded, not triumphant. Leave a short silent beat after “it” for drifting pollen or a last body wobble to answer him.

output.performanceArc: Fuzzby begins already in the approved slanting flight from @图1, chest and chin leading with inflated official confidence while his eyes and steering lag behind. After the first committed wingbeat he lip-syncs only @Audio1, turning the voice into frantic self-hype. His confidence builds through quick wingbeat pulses, then cracks into a chain of overcorrections: dodge, shoulder clip, recoil, shake-off, new near-miss. He never admits the chaos until the final pop-back, where he snaps into a tiny strained official hover, proud but visibly pollen-dusted. Zenny stays deeper in frame, level, precise, calm, mouth closed, and unaffected.
output.physicalCauseAndEffect: Fuzzby’s wings drive too hard, pushing his round body faster than he can steer. His shoulder brushes a tall stem; the stem bends, whips back, rattles nearby petals, and releases a soft pollen burst. Pollen sticks to his fur, glasses rim, wings, and belly stripes. His attempt to shake it off creates a lopsided wobble that throws him toward the next flower. Each contact has readable cause and effect: impact, spring-back, pollen bloom, late recovery. The final rebound pops him backward into a controlled hover, but the drifting pollen and tiny body tremor betray the cover-up.
output.cameraBehaviour: Single continuous bee-height camera move, no cuts. Begin exactly from @图1 composition and lighting. The camera tracks Fuzzby’s fast diagonal path as if trying to keep up, with small handheld-like float and delayed reframing, briefly losing parts of him behind foreground stems, petals, and pollen clouds. Keep Zenny readable in depth on the right side as the steady visual measure Fuzzby keeps orbiting past. Preserve character scale, environment, lens feel, warm sunset light, and flower-meadow depth unless the follow move naturally shifts the view.
output.timingAndRhythm: Full shot follows @Audio1 timing. Do not begin mouth movement on frame one; start after the first strong wingbeat. Keep Fuzzby’s mouth shapes crisp and synced to @Audio1 during the fast chant section, locked to short wingbeat accelerations and dodge-hit-recover beats. Contacts are quick and elastic: one-frame-feeling clip, stem bend, pollen bloom, late recoil. The final cover-up line lands only after the pop-back and a tiny held official pose. Leave a short final beat after the last lip-sync for pollen drift and a small involuntary wobble.
output.continuityFinish: End with Fuzzby arrested in a strained official hover near the camera path, visibly dusted with pollen across fur, glasses, wings, and belly, holding himself too stiffly while one last wobble or drifting pollen puff exposes the mishap. Pollen hangs behind him like failed parade confetti. Zenny remains deeper among the flowers, steady over her work, undisturbed, mouth closed. Maintain the approved warm meadow lighting, scale, and character identities for the next planned cut.
